title: Normalised histogram
description: A bpftrace hist()/lhist() map after post processing. One file may hold several series (for example a global histogram plus per thread breakdowns).

name.description: Logical name, e.g. 'runqlat'. Matches the file stem.

unit.description: Unit of the bucket bounds, not of the counts.

source.description: Where the data came from, e.g. 'runqlat.bt:@runq_us'. Kept for traceability.

key.description: Series identifier. Empty string for a single unkeyed histogram, otherwise the bpftrace map key (comm, tid, address, ...).

buckets.description: Ordered, non overlapping buckets. lo is inclusive, hi is exclusive. lo = null marks an open ended bottom bucket (lhist underflow) and hi = null an open ended top bucket.
